# g05 – Constrained optimization problem

## Definition
- **Objective**: Minimize f(x)
- **Variables**: n = 4
- **Domain**: 0 ≤ x_1 ≤ 1200, 0 ≤ x_2 ≤ 1200, -0.55 ≤ x_3 ≤ 0.55, -0.55 ≤ x_4 ≤ 0.55

## Mathematical Formulation

### Objective Function
```math
f(x) = 3 x_1 + 0.000001 x_1^3 + 2 x_2 + 0.000002/3 x_2^3
```

### Constraints
```math
g_1(x) = -x_4 + x_3 + 0.55 \leq 0
```
```math
g_2(x) = -x_3 + x_4 + 0.55 \leq 0
```
```math
h_1(x) = 1000 \sin(-x_3 - 0.25) + 1000 \sin(-x_4 - 0.25) + 894.8 - x_1 = 0
```
```math
h_2(x) = 1000 \sin(x_3 - 0.25) + 1000 \sin(x_3 - x_4 - 0.25) + 1294.8 - x_2 = 0
```
```math
h_3(x) = 1000 \sin(x_4 - 0.25) + 1000 \sin(x_4 - x_3 - 0.25) + 1294.8 - x_2 = 0
```

## Best Known Value
f(x*) = 5126.498
